# Final evaluation tables (auto-generated by src/final_eval.py)

Models based on the released *-cv26-* checkpoints were trained (via splits_cv26/train) on 2,199/2,299 CV-test clips and 589/596 SPS 5.0 dev+test clips: their CV/SPS numbers are marked invalid; OOD and `scr_clipclean` (100 clips in the cv26 dev split) are clean for every model.

WER / CER (%) against references in the curated orthography.
`official` = released-baseline style (greedy, no LM, no normaliser); `greedy` = greedy + learned normaliser; `beam` = beam 64 + KenLM + learned normaliser.
